text:
Jordan: Heads-up: last-minute agenda tweak for today's all-hands — moving roadmap Q&A up to before product demos. Also seeing an intermittent hiccup with the stream encoder on the room machine. Can AV Team confirm mic + recording fallback?

Priya: thanks for the heads-up. moving Q&A earlier works for product. can we keep live poll after demos?

Sam: re: encoder — I saw the same on staging earlier. ffmpeg process got OOM-killed once, then failed CVBR negotiation. paste of the tail logs below:
```
[libx264 @ 0x55d...] error: failed to allocate picture buffer
[ffmpeg] stream closed with exit code 137
```

AV Team: @Jordan we have spare USB mics if the conference mic is flaky. Recording fallback plan: start local OBS recording to NAS and stream via backup encoder on laptop. Need explicit go-ahead to kick off backup.

Jordan: go ahead with backup now. also start local recording regardless of stream health.

Liam: I'll watch cloud ingest. if we start backup encoder, we should route stream to eu-west as fallback to avoid ephemeral edge issues. I'll set up routing rule now.

OpsBot: Incident alert — streaming node infra reported increased packet drops in us-east-1 at 14:03 UTC. No customer impact yet.

Priya: can someone paste the all-hands runbook steps for an on-site fallback? I only know the high-level.

AV Team: runbook short version: 1) switch conference mix to USB mic (physical switch by stage) 2) start OBS local record (profile: all-hands-1080p) 3) enable backup RTMP on laptop to rtmp://backup.redwood/live 4) label file with timestamp + "allhands" and rsync to /mnt/nas/all-hands/recordings

Sam: FYI I'm pushing a small ffmpeg config tweak to the room box: change -crf 23 -> 25 and limit threads to 2. less memory pressure.

Jordan: thanks. @all-hands-bot can you post the updated agenda in #all-hands?

all-hands-bot: Agenda updated: Roadmap Q&A moved to 14:15-14:40, Demos at 14:45. Poll after demos.

Priya: :thumbsup: seating for remote question queue — we should remind folks to drop questions in the Q&A thread.

Liam: routing rule applied. streaming will failover to eu-west if packet loss > 3% for 10s. watching now.

AV Team: backup recorder started and upload scheduled. mic swap done.

Sam: patch applied to ffmpeg. restarted process, current uptime: 6m, no OOMs in that window.

Jordan: excellent. if anyone on stage needs a hand, ping me or AV Team. see you all in 10.

Priya: thanks all. prepping slides.

OpsBot: Recording job completed and file uploaded: /mnt/nas/all-hands/recordings/1787503210-allhands.mp4

Liam: confirmed stream health stable on eu-west fallback path. no further alerts.

Jordan: closing thread — postmortem only if we need follow-up action items. thanks everyone :clap:
